# Palisade canonical event

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/events/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

One canonical event.

Field order here is the serialisation order, so `Event::to_canonical_json`
is deterministic.

Schema: [`schemas/events/v1.json`](https://github.com/jusso-dev/palisade/blob/main/schemas/events/v1.json) (`$id` `https://github.com/jusso-dev/palisade/schemas/events/v1.json`), version 1.4.0. Regenerate the schema with `PALISADE_BLESS=1 cargo test -p palisade-proto --test events_schema`, then these pages with `cargo xtask docs generate`.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| `description` | string | yes |  | 1 to 1024 characters | 1.0.0 | A human-readable description of the event (ISM-0585). |

## Object types

- [`Account`](account.md): An account or group in a directory or on the device.
- [`Admin`](admin.md): An administrative action on the server (#132).
- [`AgentInfo`](agent-info.md): Agent state.
- [`Aggregate`](aggregate.md): The count an aggregated event carries. Counts are exact: every occurrence is in exactly one aggregate or one single event.
- [`Approval`](approval.md): An approval request and its decision.
- [`AuditPolicy`](audit-policy.md): A change to the OS audit policy.
- [`CacheStats`](cache-stats.md): Cache counters.
- [`Change`](change.md): One change to an object.
- [`Device`](device.md): A peripheral device.
- [`Elevation`](elevation.md): A privilege elevation.
- [`File`](file.md): The file an event is about: the target of a decision.
- [`Fim`](fim.md): A change to a monitored file (#183). The file as it is now is `super::Event::file`; this records what it was before.
- [`Hashes`](hashes.md): The digests of a file.
- [`Host`](host.md): The device an event is about.
- [`Identity`](identity.md): Identity details: logons and group membership changes. The account that logged on, or that made a change, is `super::Event::user`.
- [`Loss`](loss.md): One kind of loss.
- [`Native`](native.md): Details from OS-native enforcement: the OS code integrity and legacy rule-collection engines.
- [`Network`](network.md): A network connection or request.
- [`Origin`](origin.md): Where a file came from.
- [`ParentProcess`](parent-process.md): A parent process. It has no parent of its own: the grandparent is summarised on the child.
- [`PolicyRef`](policy-ref.md): The Palisade policy and rule behind a decision.
- [`Principal`](principal.md): Who acted, as the server knows them.
- [`Probe`](probe.md): One compliance probe and its result (#210).
- [`Process`](process.md): The process that acted.
- [`ProcessSummary`](process-summary.md): A short description of a process.
- [`Registry`](registry.md): A registry key or value.
- [`RegistryData`](registry-data.md): Registry value data: recorded truncated, hashed, or both, never in full beyond the preview limit.
- [`Restriction`](restriction.md): A restriction a script interpreter applied, or in audit mode would have applied, because the script is not allowed to run unrestricted.
- [`Script`](script.md): A script.
- [`Signer`](signer.md): One signature on a file, leaf first.
- [`Source`](source.md): The log an event was translated from.
- [`User`](user.md): The user an event is about.
- [`VersionInfo`](version-info.md): The version resource of a PE file.

Enumerations and string formats: [Value types](types.md).
